integrity: Proof uses a universal reduction to five-edge unlabeled graphs and a complete finite cut certificate. The embedded standard-library checker is fully self-contained and independently repeats labelled trace tests. Same-model review does not constitute independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Covers only open neighborhoods of J(n,2); excludes all other Johnson parameters. The cardinality bound for open Johnson neighborhoods was established in arXiv:2007.16042. The new assessment concerns the exact support enumerator and graph-cut classification. Historical priority beyond inspected sources is not comprehensive; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Exact open-neighborhood shattering polynomial of triangular graphs
